Known and accepted (blueprint risk): on whatsmeow the adapter's own PLAZO_CIERRE_DE_SESION (30 s) races the route's 30 s, so a hung sidecar in production yields 502 with the adapter timeout text rather than 504; both are non-200, so the sibling never destroys the volume.
Low: let _ = ...registrar(...) silently discards a double registration; it cannot happen with the current single-registration-per-arm layout and a miss still fails closed (502).
